text: …　…　…　うーん　つきあっても　いいかな

structure.jp: つきあっても　いいかな
structure.en: I suppose I could go along with you

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.span: つきあっても　いい
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus も いい says that doing it is okay. つきあっても　いい = 'it's fine to go along with you'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder' and here softens the answer into 'I guess'. いいかな = 'I guess it's okay'.
